annotations.title: UK vehicle safety recalls by make and model

description: Published UK safety recalls for a car make, or a make and model, from DVSA recall data: number of recalls, the most recent, and each recall reference with the build dates it covers. Whether one particular car is affected depends on its build date and VIN, so for a specific car run the free MotifyMe check with its registration first, which shows any outstanding recall.

registration.description: Optional UK registration of the car, to link the free check
